claim: SoWLoader installs MinHook trampoline hooks (call-original, non-destructive) on five hardcoded game functions: CUIFrontEndRootLayer ctor, OnWorldLoad, save-to-front-end clear, front-end item refresh, and the per-frame cursor recenter, the last of which drains a 128-slot game-thread task queue.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001. Offsets are hardcoded file RVAs (no pattern scan, no version gate), so any mismatch with 1.0.8874.0 would silently hook wrong code.
limitations: Using the cursor-recenter function as a game-thread tick is an author heuristic; it is not shown to run every frame in all states.
next_experiment: Identify a proper per-frame main-thread tick in our build (static RE) instead of relying on the cursor recenter helper.
